entries.en: Invaders! Your every step is a transgression. A thousand feelers appraise you as meat, good only to dig or decompose.
I speak for the Old Growth, as I did for Saren. You are within and before the Thorian. It commands that you be in awe!
Saren sought knowledge of those who are gone. The Old Growth listened to flesh for the first time in the Long Cycle. Trades were made.
Then cold ones began killing the flesh that would tend the next cycle. Flesh fairly given! The Old Growth sees the air you push as lies! It will listen no more!
No more will the Thorian listen to those that scurry. Your lives are short, but have gone on too long.
Your blood will feed the ground and the new growth!
The Thorian is a piece of this world, extending across the land and back through the ages. You can no more kill it than cut the sky.
I'm free. I'm free.
I will do what I can to assist the colony in this difficult time. I am ashamed of the damage  done to the lives of these people.
You gave something to Saren. Something I need.
Give me what I need and I'll strike back at the one who betrayed you.
I won't let you keep your thralls. Release them. Now!
I don't argue with plants. Give me what I want. Now!
You enslaved the colonists! You destroyed their minds. I don't know what Saren wanted with you, but I just want you dead!
I-- I suppose I should thank you for releasing me.
I will remain here until the last of your kind is gone. I am greatly ashamed for what happened here.
To understand, you must have access to endemic ancestral memory. A viewpoint spanning thousands of Prothean generations.
I sensed this ancestral memory--the Cipher--when I melded with the Thorian. Our identities merged, our minds intertwined. Such knowledge cannot be taught; it simply exists.
There is a way. I can transfer the knowledge from my mind to yours, as I did with Saren.
I have given you the Cipher, just as it was given to Saren. The ancestral memories of the Protheans are a part of you now.
Are you all right, Shepard? What did she do?
You have been given a great gift: the experience of an entire people. It will take time for your mind to process this information.
Are you all right? What just happened?
What was that? Shepard, are you all right?
What just happened? Are you okay?
A knowledge bond can be very traumatic. Are you all right, Commander Shepard?
The Cipher is the very essence of being a Prothean. It cannot be described or explained. It would be like describing color to a creature without eyes.
I saw... something. It still didn't make any sense.
All I saw were more weird visions. It still didn't make sense!
Farewell, Commander. I wish you well in your hunt.
Farewell, Shiala.
I'm okay.
She messed up my mind!
Goodbye.
I need what Saren came for.
I'll destroy you!
I'm after Saren.
Let the colonists go.
Enough negotiating.
This flesh is reborn! You will be destroyed!
The Old Growth is older than you can fathom!
The Long Cycle must continue!
You are nothing! Nutrients to feed upon!
I am fine. Or I will be, in time.
This is no trick. The Thorian is dead and I am myself again.
My name is Shiala. I serve-- I served Matriarch Benezia. When she allied herself with Saren, so did I.
I came to this world in search of the Thorian. Saren needed its knowledge. And he needed my biotic abilities to communicate with it.
Is everything all right? Are you hurt?
How do I know this isn't some kind of trick?
How did you end up inside that... thing?
Are you okay?
I don't trust you.
Who are you?
Saren offered me in trade. I was sacrificed to secure an alliance between Saren and the Thorian.
Saren is quick to betray his followers and his allies. Once he had what he needed, he ordered his geth to destroy the Thorian.
He was quick to betray the Thorian, too. After he had what he wanted, he ordered the geth to destroy all evidence of its existence.
Saren knows you are searching for the Conduit. He knows you are following his steps. He attacked the Thorian so you could not gain the Cipher.
That's what you get for trusting Saren.
Saren's pretty quick to betray his own people.
Then why were the geth trying to destroy the Thorian?
What's the Cipher? And why did Saren need it?
Serves you right.
That's horrible!
They were allies?
Tell me what it is.
The beacon on Eden Prime gave you visions. But the visions are unclear, confusing. They were meant for a Prothean mind.
To truly comprehend them, you must think like a Prothean. You must understand their culture, their history, their very existence.
The Thorian was here long before the Protheans built this city. It watched and studied them. When they died, it consumed them. They became a part of it.
Sounds like you asari got in over your heads for once.
She tried to manipulate Saren. But in the end, her plan backfired.
She tried to manipulate Saren. But in the end, her plan backfired.
Typical asari meddling. About time it bit you in the ass.
Benezia sought to turn the river and was swept away.
Benezia underestimated Saren. As I did. We came to believe in his cause and his goals. The strength of his influence is troubling.
Saren has a vessel. An enormous warship unlike anything I've ever seen. He calls it Sovereign. It can dominate the minds of his followers.
They become indoctrinated to Saren's will. The process is subtle. It can take days, weeks. But in the end, it is absolute.
Your suspicions are understandable. But you freed me from the Thorian, and from Saren. I am on your side now.
If you allow it, I would like to stay here with the colonists. They have suffered greatly, and I played a role in their suffering. I would like to make amends.
So be it. If this is the fate you feel I deserve, then I will not resist.
Thank you, Commander. May fortune smile upon you.
Then I wish good fortune upon you. Saren must be stopped before he finds the Conduit. As for me, I will stay here with the colonists.
I feel great shame for my part in their suffering. As long as any of the colonists remain on this world, I will do whatever I can to aid and protect them.
Just give me some plain answers! Where is the Cipher?
So the Thorian taught Saren to think like a Prothean? How?
Where is the Cipher? How do I get it?
You chose to side with Saren. So did Matriarch Benezia.
Are you saying Saren can control minds?
Asari Matriarchs are among the most intelligent and powerful beings in the galaxy. How could one fall under Saren's control?
Now that you're free of the Thorian, what are you planning to do next?
You were allied with Saren. For all I know, you still are. I can't just let you walk away.
You change sides too often. I have no choice. You must die.
The colonists will need all the help they can get. They'll be happy to have you on their side.
I can't spend any more time here. Not while Saren's still out looking for the Conduit.
What else can you tell me about Saren?
Tell me more about this ship Saren has.
I want to know more about Benezia.
Is there anything else you can tell me about the Thorian?
I want to know more about you.
Enough mystic crap!
So the Cipher is knowledge?
I don't understand.
Quit making excuses.
What do you mean?
There's more to this.
What should I do with you?
I can't let you go.
I should leave.
I can't let you live.
A noble idea.
Sounds good to me.
Saren
Sovereign
The Matriarch
The Thorian
Personal questions
You look a little queasy. We should get you back to the ship.
We should get you back to the ship where you can be monitored.
You look pretty rough. We should get you back to the ship.
We should get you back to the ship, Commander. Medical needs to know about this.
You look a little unsteady, Shepard. Perhaps you should return to the Normandy.
I am sorry if you have suffered, but there was no other way. You needed the Cipher. In time, it will help you understand the vision from the beacon.
There is little I could tell you that you do not already know. He is powerful. He is charismatic. And he is dangerous.
Once I followed him, blind to his true nature. But now I see he is leading the galaxy into an age of darkness and suffering.
Sovereign is alien. I do not know how it was built, or where it comes from. Its design does not match that of any known spacefaring species.
It dwarfs any vessel in the Citadel or Alliance fleets. Its weapons are devastating; its defenses, virtually impenetrable. With it, Saren believes he is unstoppable.
The indoctrination. There is an energy about Sovereign. You feel drawn to the ship. It makes Saren's arguments more persuasive, more compelling.
Spend enough time in Sovereign's presence and you will lose yourself. There is no other way to explain it.
Benezia was greatly respected among our people. A powerful biotic, even for an asari. She was widely known as a teacher of philosophy and religion.
She always sought the paths of peace and harmony. She joined with Saren because she hoped to turn him away from his path of destruction.
As I mentioned before, Matriarch Benezia underestimated Saren. Be sure you do not make the same mistake.
No. I'm sorry. All I know is that Saren believes the Conduit was the key to the Prothean extinction.
That can't be good, whatever it is.
Well then whatever it is, we can't let him have it.
That can't be good, whatever it is.
Then whatever it is, we cannot let him have it.
Then whatever it is, we can't let him have it.
You have the Cipher. In time, your visions will clear. They will lead you to the Conduit. I only pray you find it before Saren does.
When the creature enveloped me, I became part of it. But I still don't truly understand it. So alien. So ancient.
Its exact age is impossible to know. It measured time differently. Ten thousand years of hibernation broken by a few frantic centuries of activity.
Its mind was awesome. Magnificent. It transcended all classification. And now it is gone.
The Thorian was a unique life-form -- a sentient being that lived for 50,000 years, maybe more. There is nothing even remotely like it in the known galaxy.
I am grateful you saved me from a life of thralldom. Yet I cannot help but feel some sorrow for the loss of such a rare and remarkable creature.
There is nothing remarkable about me. I was merely one of Matriarch Benezia's disciples. For nearly two centuries, I followed her, learning at her feet.
When Benezia revealed her plan to join Saren, she gave her disciples a choice. Only those who were willing had to follow her. Many felt her plan was too dangerous.
But I believed in her. I thought she could turn Saren away from his insanity. Instead, we joined him in it.
You said Saren uses it to manipulate his followers.
Instead, she became one of his most powerful allies.
Do you know what the Conduit is? Or where it is?
The galaxy's a better place with that thing dead and gone.
Don't tell me you feel sorry for that thing.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
The Conduit
It controls minds?
It backfired.
It was an abomination!
You sound almost sad.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Benezia foresaw the influence Saren would have. She joined him to guide him down a gentler path. But Saren is compelling. Benezia lost her way.
After Saren had what he needed, the Thorian became a liability.
I was a willing slave when Saren brought me to this world. He needed my biotics to communicate with the Thorian, to learn its secrets.
I'm here to make a deal.
He tricked her?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
What does it do?
Try to relax, Commander. Slow, deep breaths. Let go of your physical shell. Reach out to grasp the threads that bind us, one to another.
Every action sends ripples across the galaxy. Every idea must touch another mind to live. Each emotion must mark another's spirit.
Embrace eternity!
I need that knowledge to stop Saren!
You taught Saren. You can teach me.
I need the Cipher.
There has to be some way!
You gave it to Saren.
I need that information.
We are all connected. Every living being united in a single, glorious existence. Open yourself to the universe, Commander.
I have the cutting the ExoGeni assayer wanted. Now we just have to... we just have to....
All right, we just need to find this creature and determine what it... what it....
Okay, by the numbers. We just need to find... to find....
Okay, we just have to find this thing and put a couple rounds into....
All right, we just need to find this creature and determine what... what it....
All right, we just need to find this creature and determine what it... what it....
That is the cutting for the assayer. Now we just have to....
Keelah, what is that?
What... is that?
What the hell is that?
That is... disturbing.
This was not covered by my training manuals.
Okay, we have the cutting for the assayer. Now we just have to... we just have to....
Okay, that's the cutting for the assayer. Now we just have to... we just have to....
I have the cutting for the assayer. All that remains is... is to... oh my.
That does not look like any plant I've ever seen. This may be... problematic.
We are going to need bigger guns.
Nothing's ever simple, is it?
That's a plant?
That's... large.
Well, that's just great.
Over here, Commander! Definitely something different in this area.
Here, Commander! There's a... node... or something. Worth looking at.
Commander! Some sort of growth in here. Check it out.
Commander Shepard, there's something here. A growth of some kind.
Commander, there's some kind of growth here that is definitely different.
That hurt it. I can tell. A few more of those and it's in trouble.
That's a start. We'll bring it down yet.
That got its attention. Has to be more of those around.
That had the desired effect, I believe. A few more and it will be severely hurt.
We've stung it! I'm sure of that. We need to find more of these... things.
It is hurting, Commander Shepard. We're on the right track.
Almost there, Commander. That thing has to drop soon.
We've got it on the ropes now, Commander. It has to drop soon!
Almost there, Commander. That thing has to drop soon.
That thing has to drop soon. A few more. I think.
It appears the Thorian has gained my compatriot's biotic abilities in addition to her voice.
It seems it has learned more than speech from the commando. Biotics too.
Looks like it learned a few biotic tricks from that commando.
Looks like it learned a few biotic tricks from that commando it copied.
It seems to have copied a few of the commando's biotic abilities.
We must find a weak spot on the creature before more copies of the asari show up!
We need to find a weak spot on this thing before more of those copies show up.
I've had it with these plant-people, Commander. Find me a weak spot on this thing.
We need to find a weak spot on this thing before more of those copies show up.
